name: zed
description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
one_liner: A fast, modern code editor built for programmers to write and pair-program together smoothly.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small dev shop deciding which editor to standardize the team on, or a plugin developer selling add-ons for it.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools consultancy offers 'migrate your team off VS Code to Zed' packages with custom keybindings and extension setup.
A plugin developer builds and sells premium Zed extensions (themes, language integrations) through a small storefront.
An educator sells a course on real-time pair-programming workflows built around Zed's multiplayer editing.

money_ideas.idea: Consulting service helping engineering teams migrate to and configure Zed

steal_this: Build and sell two or three polished Zed extensions (a theme pack, a niche language integration) this weekend and list them for a few dollars each.
